primer: SK hynix (NASDAQ: SKHY / KRX: 000660) has engineered a historic fundamental ascent, capturing 50%–58% of global HBM revenue, ~70% of initial HBM4 allocations, and >50% LTA coverage for 2027–2028 capacity . FY2025 revenue reached KRW 97.15T (48.6% operating margin), while Q3 2026 revenue hit KRW 104.62T (79.7% margin) with 71.84% ROIC and ~$42.96B net cash . Yet strong operations do not make a safe stock at $131.79. We assign **CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL** business quality (`PASS` KPIs), **REJECTED** (`TREND`) for new capital, and **EXIT_IMMEDIATELY** for our 17.764 held Schwab shares .
